visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor living room scene. A young Asian woman with long black hair sits on a black leather sofa. She wears a purple oversized t-shirt with 'Monday' text. She holds a smartphone, staring at it with a wide smile and occasionally covering her mouth in excitement. A large grey cat-shaped plush pillow sits on her lap. Behind her are wooden shelves packed with various manga books and a small genie lamp decoration. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the woman's face. She exhibits high arousal, squinting her eyes while laughing silently. She leans forward and tightly hugs the grumpy-looking cat pillow, burying her face into it. The lighting is warm and consistent indoor ambient light. (3) Outdoor transition scene. The woman walks across a busy urban crosswalk. She is now wearing a black polka-dot spaghetti strap top and grey wide-leg trousers. She carries a black mesh bag. The background features modern high-rise buildings and city traffic under a bright, slightly overcast sky. (4) Indoor bedroom/vanity scene. The woman peers curiously through white vertical curtains. Then, she is shown in front of a circular ring-light mirror, touching her face and looking closely at her skin texture with a worried expression. (5) Product demonstration scene. She holds up a silver Neutrogena serum bottle and a purple cream jar. She uses a dropper to apply a clear liquid to her cheek and massages it with her fingers. Detailed shots show the texture of the serum and cream being spread on her hand and face. (6) Conclusion scene. The woman stands in front of a wooden door, smiling brightly at the camera. She forms a heart shape with her hands over her chest. She then holds both products up to the frame, posing with a confident and happy expression.
